title: Evaluation of Clinical Impact of Interruption VS Maintenance of AI in Patients With Locally Advanced/ Metastatic Low Grade Endometrial Stromal Sarcoma (LGESS)
official: Randomized Comparative Prospective Multicentre Phase II Trial Evaluating Clinical Impact of Interruption VS Maintenance of AI in Patients With Locally Advanced/ Metastatic LGESS
summary: The primary objective is to compare the progression-free survival (PFS) between aromatase inhibitors interruption and aromatase inhibitors maintenance strategies in patients with a locally advanced or metastatic Low Grade Endometrial Stromal Sarcoma (LGESS).
